match.userMessage: One greyscale storyboard frame. Frozen in this action: SCARLETT makes a quick touch-up in the glass. Framing: close-up, eye level, SCARLETT’s reflected face and lipstick fill the frame, with the dark window providing a clean background. Placement only, not the pose: SCARLETT holds the lipstick near her mouth, looking at her reflection. Camera, as one or two arrows: handheld drift, precise and brisk. Characters: Scarlett, Woman, 22, A striking, fresh-faced 22-year-old beauty creator: dewy, even, Black fitted turtleneck, slim black trousers, small gold. The bodies are frozen in that action: if someone sits, they are seated; if someone reaches, the arm is extended. One figure per character. Drawn as a storyboard artist's animatic frame: confident pencil line with flat grey marker tones, three or four values, greyscale only even where the description names a colour. Clear silhouettes, the set blocked in with simple shapes. Camera travel is one or two arrows. A rough pre-production drawing: not a finished illustration, not a photo, not a 3D render. The drawing fills the whole image edge to edge: no border, no frame line, no paper margin, no grid of panels. No text, no titles, no subtitles, no watermarks, no letters, no words, no signs, no UI elements.
